notes.title: Revision of the Chinese Translation
notes.content:
We have learned that the quality of the Chinese translation did not meet the standards we had hoped for in Feed All Monsters.

A revised version has been integrated with this patch.

Please let us know what you think of it. :)

notes.title: Feed All Monsters Community Items!!
notes.content:
To all the hard-working monster feeders,

we are pleased to announce that we can finally release trading cards, profile backgrounds, and emoticons. We thank you for your support in feeding the cute little monsters!

As a small side note: We are currently working on our next title "Mizi NO!", which will be available for [b]free[/b]. Check it out and add it to your wishlist, please 😉

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2654860/Mizi_NO/

notes.title: Language Update & Bugfix!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

With this update, we are adding the Finnish, Arabic, and Turkish languages!

Furthermore, a bug has been fixed that was causing the game to freeze when the Throwing Pan was thrown out of the game area. Thanks for reporting it!

We appreciate your support and wish you a great start to the week!

notes.title: Portal fix and mini language update
notes.content:
Hello!

A bug involving the throwing pan and two portals that made the game crash was fixed.
Also some smaller adjustments for the different languages were made.

Have a good start into the weekend everyone!

notes.title: Price raise on 13 July
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It makes us very happy to read all the positive comments about Feed All Monsters!

We originally intended to launch the game at a $4.99 price point, but you are currently getting it at a more than 50% discount for $2.39 due to a mistake. 

We love that our biggest fans can get the game for a discount, but once Summer Sale is over, we will raise the price to what was initially intended.

So if you are on the fence about getting the game, now is the best time because it will be [b]years[/b] before you can get it this cheap again. 

We wish you a lot of fun feeding the monsters!

notes.title: Savegame Issue for DEMO players
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

This patch is a hotfix that addresses an issue with the save file location. For those who have played the Feed All Monsters Demo, there is a crash occurring because the game is currently trying to access the old save file. With this patch, a new file will be created to bypass this problem.

For those who are already playing:
The hotfix should not affect your game progress. However, if you encounter any issues, please check the name of your save file using the following steps:

Press the Windows key.
Type "%localappdata%" and press Enter. A folder will open.
Open the "FeedAllMonsters" folder.
If there is a file named "savegame_full," simply rename it to "savegame."
We apologize for any inconvenience caused!
